hook_formula: High-stakes supernatural exile premise paired with fast action immediately pulls viewers into the narrative.
story_arc: Setup: An exiled goddess moves in with the town's worst kid. Escalation: Misunderstandings and magic ruin his attempts at good deeds. Twist: The goddess deliberately sabotaged him to avoid returning to Heaven. Payoff: He intentionally breaks rules to stay with her.

visual_style.background_details: Simple low-poly Roblox environments featuring basic furniture, window blinds, storefront signs, and minimal crowd assets.

character_archetypes.outfit_style: Green and black long-sleeve striped sweater with dark pants
White divine robes with gold embellishments and a floating yellow halo
Red top and white backwards cap

character_interactions: Front-facing medium two-shots during dialogue, tight inserts on shared props, and symmetrical side-by-side roof seating for emotional intimacy.
visual_gags_and_fx: Paper homework transforming into a flying bird

source_transcript: A goddess got kicked out of Heaven. She can only go back when I become a good person. Heaven's list says I'm the worst kid in town. I once forgot to return a library book, so she moved into my room. She took my bed. I took the floor. She made me do my homework. It turned into a bird and flew away. She made me share my lunch with the bully. It exploded in his face. She sent me to bed early. I woke up the next afternoon. Every time I got in trouble, her halo glowed a little brighter and she smiled. She tried pizza for the first time. She ate eleven slices. She sat with me on the roof every night counting stars. I didn't want her to leave, but a goddess belongs in Heaven. So I tried my hardest. I helped every old lady cross the street. I gave my piggy bank to the dog shelter. That night I caught her turning my homework into a bird. She'd been doing it all along. She never wanted to go back. Heaven doesn't have pizza or me. Now I forget to return a library book every single week.
